children.name: Slot-based desktop top bar with 3 zones (Leading, Center, Trailing) separated by 2 FILL spacers for true-centered middle content. Drop in any DS components — workspace switchers, search bars, tabs, action toolbars, profile menus. Build navigation shells for SaaS apps, admin dashboards, marketing sites, e-commerce.
2 variants (Elevated=off/on) · 3 SLOT properties · 11 tokens · 2 spacers FILL between slots
Use this component in your design!
Brand identity & entry context — keep minimal
• Icon Only Button (hamburger menu, back button)
Primary nav or page context — empty by default
• Empty Spacer (default — many top bars don't need center)
• Search Bar (Base Input with search icon)
• Action Bar with notifications + settings + profile (default toolkit)
• Entity Card (avatar + name + chevron — full profile)

Mobile top bar with 4 variants — 2 Types (Mobile, Standard) × 2 Elevation states (off, on). Built from circular Icon Only Buttons with frosted glass background blur (BG blur on button frames), perfect for iOS/Android native app patterns. Page title + leading menu + trailing search baked in.
4 variants · 6 Mobile tokens + 6 Global tokens · Icon Only Button (Ghost L, perfect circle) · BG blur frosted glass
Use this component in your design!
Floating mobile top bar — menu button + search button (each circular with frosted glass background) + page title row below. Use on scrollable content where elevation isn't needed.
Same as above but buttons get drop shadows for depth. Use over busy/image backgrounds where buttons need separation.
Compact horizontal top bar — leading menu icon + center page title + trailing search icon. Most common pattern (Material/iOS native). Use for full-app navigation shells.
Same as Standard above but with bottom shadow for separation from scrolling content. Use as sticky/fixed top bar.
📱 Native mobile apps (iOS/Android) — sticky top navigation
🌐 PWAs & responsive web — mobile breakpoint top bar
🛒 E-commerce mobile — product browsing + cart access
📰 Content apps — article reading with menu + search
